args.title: Retail Returns & Resale – Summary
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a major cost center for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs reduced handling costs by roughly 20% (a fifth), showing centralization pays off operationally.
- The companion piece highlights that reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of the original margin, underscoring the importance of fast resale turnaround.
